detail: The Grunfeld investment panel (invest, market, stock by company and time), a subset of stata_grunfeld's grunfeld.dta: its first rows are company 1 of that table, the same invest, mvalue and kstock values. company groups firms over years, but the grouped table is filed as grunfeld.dta; the [XT] xtgls / xtpcse / sureg examples on it carry no random effect.
OECD crop production by LOCATION (country), SUBJECT, MEASURE and TIME; LOCATION groups the rows, but Value mixes measures of different units (MEASURE), so the table has no single defensible response.
